{{Quote|Their leader calls himself the Ratcatcher. He's a bounty hunter of renown, hired only by word of mouth. He's assassinated everyone from corporate heads to Moffs.|Captain Hanthor|<ref name="Mission" />}}
The '''Ratcatcher''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was renowned during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]], having [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] a wide variety of targets. He led the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group known as the [[Specialists]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], where the group was [[Death/Legends|killed]].
